name: Lookup Provider
plugin_description: Sync medications, pharmacies, and providers from call transcripts to Contact records
action_description: Search the NLM NPI Registry for a single provider by individual fields and return candidate matches - no records are created or modified

inputs.name: alternate_first_names
inputs.label: Alternate First Names
inputs.description: Comma-separated alternate first name spellings (e.g. "Jon, Johnny")

inputs.name: specialty_search_terms
inputs.label: Specialty Search Terms
inputs.description: Comma-separated specialty terms to filter by (e.g. "Cardiology, Internal Medicine")

inputs.name: zip
inputs.label: Zip
inputs.description: Zip code of the provider's practice location

inputs.name: state
inputs.label: State
inputs.description: State of the provider's practice location

inputs.name: city
inputs.label: City
inputs.description: City of the provider's practice location

inputs.name: search_strategy
inputs.label: Search Strategy
inputs.description: 'radius' to expand search to nearest 100 zip codes, 'targeted' to use the exact location (city/state or zip) without expansion.

inputs.name: streets
inputs.label: Streets
inputs.description: Comma-separated street address hints to narrow results (e.g. 'Main St, Elm St')

inputs.name: street_number
inputs.label: Street Number
inputs.description: Street number to further narrow results when multiple candidates have the same street name

outputs.name: match_status
outputs.label: Match Status
outputs.description: Result of the lookup: 'Match' if exactly 1 candidate found, 'No Match' if 0 candidates found, or 'Ambiguous' if multiple candidates found

outputs.name: provider_npi
outputs.label: NPI
outputs.description: NPI of the matched provider if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: provider_name
outputs.label: Provider Name
outputs.description: Human-readable provider name (first + last) if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: provider_alias
outputs.label: Provider Alias
outputs.description: Provider's other name if they have one (e.g. maiden name) if match_status is 'Match' and other name exists, otherwise null

outputs.name: provider_street
outputs.label: Street
outputs.description: Provider practice street address if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: provider_city
outputs.label: City
outputs.description: Provider practice city if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: provider_state
outputs.label: State
outputs.description: Provider practice state if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: provider_zipcode
outputs.label: Zipcode
outputs.description: Provider practice zipcode if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: provider_phone
outputs.label: Phone
outputs.description: Provider practice phone number if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: provider_specialty
outputs.label: Specialty
outputs.description: Provider specialty if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: failure_message
outputs.label: Failure Message
outputs.description: Human-readable explanation of why the match failed, ready for display

outputs.name: candidate_matches
outputs.label: Candidate Matches
outputs.description: JSON array of display strings when match_status is 'Ambiguous', formatted as 'Name, Credential - Specialty - City, State'
